assumptions.choice: Trailing take-profit: track the highest high reached since entry; close when price retraces >= 50% of the peak's gain over entry (Close-based).
assumptions.reason: Spec's fixed-price example (3717) is asset-specific and not transferable to AAPL; the spec's other stated option, 'a percentage retracement from the move's high,' is generic, so it was implemented with a declared 50% threshold since no exact percentage was given.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss placed at the low of the identified selling-pressure (long-upper-wick) candle, checked intrabar via Low[0].
assumptions.reason: Spec says the stop should be 'close to the entry point'; the most recent swing low immediately preceding entry is the nearest structural level available.

assumptions.choice: Risk-based sizing: risk 1% of current broker value per trade; size = floor(risk_amount / (entry_close - stop_price)).
assumptions.reason: Spec states sizing must be risk-based (1-2% of capital) but gives no exact percentage; chose the conservative end of the stated range and used live portfolio value as 'trading capital'.

assumptions.choice: Implemented as a hard requirement (breakout-bar volume > 20-period SMA of volume) rather than a soft weighting.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader entries are boolean; a 'weight increase' has no direct mechanical meaning, so it was operationalized as a required elevated-volume filter at the breakout bar. Period (20) unstated, chosen as a common default.

assumptions.choice: True 15-minute chart is unavailable (only a single 1-minute feed is provided). Approximated by manually aggregating 1-minute closes into 15-bar buckets and comparing the latest bucket close to the mean of the last 20 buckets (min 5 buckets required); checked once, at breakout confirmation.
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies only one 1m PandasData feed, so a genuine higher-timeframe series cannot be constructed; this is the closest literal proxy.

assumptions.choice: Entries only allowed within the first 120 minutes of the trading day (day-bar-count <= 120).
assumptions.reason: Spec requires an entry-time cutoff 'within a specified time' but does not give a number; 120 minutes was chosen as a reasonable declared default.

assumptions.choice: 'Long upper wick' = (High - max(Open,Close)) >= 2x candle body (or any positive wick on a zero-body/doji candle), evaluated only while price is within the 38.2%-61.8% Fib zone.
assumptions.reason: Spec names the pattern qualitatively without a numeric threshold; 2x body was chosen as a defensible, declared multiplier.

assumptions.choice: Entry fires on a bullish candle (Close>Open) whose Close exceeds the High of the previously identified selling-pressure candle.
assumptions.reason: Operationalizes the spec's qualitative description 'price starts to recover... and shows signs of continuation upward.'

assumptions.choice: After a position closes, the state machine resets to 'waiting for breakout' (rather than ending for the day), so a new OR-breakout/pullback cycle can produce another trade the same day.
assumptions.reason: Spec restricts holding only one position at a time (canonical default) but does not cap the number of sequential trades per day.

assumptions.choice: The manually aggregated 15-minute close buffer used for the trend filter is not reset at day boundaries; it persists continuously across days.
assumptions.reason: A real higher-timeframe chart's trend context does not reset overnight, so continuity was preserved for a more faithful trend read.
